name: Montopoli in Val d'Arno (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow mount of six hillocks topped by a Latin cross supported by two mice (the arms of Montopoli in Val d'Arno).
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 12 July 2018.

features.role: mount of six hillocks topped by a Latin cross supported by two mice
